The net exposure is the product of all three.

First, multiply 7 and -29:  
7 × (-29) = -203  

Then multiply -203 by -1186:  
-203 × -1186 = positive result (since negative × negative = positive).  

203 × 1186:  
200 × 1186 = 237200  
3 × 1186 = 3558  
Sum: 237200 + 3558 = 240758  

So the result is 240758.
